PORT.description: Server listen port. Railway maps this to the public domain.

TRIVY_LISTEN.description: Bind address for the Trivy server. Must match PORT.

TRIVY_CACHE_BACKEND.description: Cache backend for the vulnerability database. 'fs' stores locally. Use 'redis://redis:6379' with a Redis companion for shared cache.

TRIVY_SKIP_DB_UPDATE.description: Skip automatic vulnerability database updates on startup. Not recommended.

TRIVY_DB_REPOSITORY.description: OCI repository to pull the vulnerability database from.

TRIVY_SCANNERS.description: Enabled scanner types. Comma-separated: vuln, misconfig, secret, license.
